content: पैतामह {%a.%} (-ही|{%f.%}) [पितामह-अण्] .²1 Relating to a paternal grandfather. .²2 Inherited or derived from a paternal grandfather. .²3 Derived from, presided over by, or relating to, Brahmā; यच्च पैतामहं स्थानम् <ls>Mb. 12. 160. 32</ls>; अयोध्या सृष्टलोकेव सद्यः पैतामही तनुः (बभौ) <ls>R. 15. 60</ls>. .{@-हाः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) Ancestors, forefathers. .{@-हम्@} The lunar mansion Rohiṇī.
